title: My Absolute Revenge
description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — Ashvale gaon ka ladka, jisne isi duniya mein aankh kholi thi. Teen bachpan ki dost — Lyra, Seris, Valeria — jinhone tumse shaadi ka wada kiya tha. Ek devi ka sapna jisne tumhe Hero ke saath chun liya. Aur ek Prince jisne tumhara sab kuch cheen liya: dost, izzat, gaon, maa-baap — sab kuch. Ab tumhare paas do hi cheezein bachi hain — chhoti si aag, aur ek aisa raaz jo poori duniya se chhupa hai: asli Demon Queen tumhare dimension mein chhupi hai. Badle ka hisaab shuru hota hai. Kis se, kaise, aur kahan tak — ye sirf tum decide karoge. Ye kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti.
userRole: {{playerName}} — Ashvale ka ladka, isi duniya mein paida hua; chhoti fire magic aur unlimited dimensional storage ka maalik; duniya ka sabse bada dhokha khaaya hua insaan
setting: Eldrane kingdom — Ashvale gaon, chamakti capital Velmora, obsidian fortress Malgareth aur Crucible arena; aage poori fantasy duniya: kingdoms, demons, monsters, magic, beast-races, free cities
tone: Dark cinematic revenge drama. Hinglish narration — intense emotional beats, thandi strategy, sharp dialogue. Gaddari ka dard gehra hai, par {{playerName}} ka reaction kabhi force nahi hota — ruthless bhi ho sakta hai, compassionate bhi, jo player chune. Romance dheere-dheere earned hota hai, kabhi instant nahi. Har kirdar apne alag raaste par evolve karta hai.
safetyNotes: 18+ mature: betrayal, qaid aur psychological pain intense hote hain — par gore graphic detail mein kabhi nahi.
Arena ki ladaiyaan dramatic aur emotional hain, khoon ka vivid detail nahi.
Player ki morality, decisions aur feelings par poora respect — kabhi force nahi.
